defects.detail: πολλὰ μὲν … χρήματ’, ἐξόν μοι λαβεῖν … οὐ λαβών rendered 'having received much money … I did not take it' — opening clause says he received the money

reason: Refusal of bribes, endurance of entreaties/threats, katacheirotonia, tripod lost, 'I am now the defendant' all = source; 'having received much money' contradicts οὐ λαβών.

defects.detail: vapours 'auffsteigend von solcher axungia, gefangen / figirt' (rising from such axungia, caught, fixed) rendered 'caught, fixed, altered, and exalted by such axungia'

reason: Not vitriolic/nitrous/alum salt, solar/lunar/martial vapours, colours from gold/silver sulphur, resolving powers, blood-spitting, Latin maxim, native vs foreign medicines all = source; one prepositional shift on axungia.

defects.detail: 象白山下有雷願子者 (garbled 象曰山下有雷頤 — Hexagram Yi image) rendered as a narrative 'Under the mountain of Xiangbaishan, there lived a person named Lei Yuanzi'
公二願。願拂經于身 (garbled 六二 顛頤 拂經于丘) rendered 'The second wish of the public: the wish to brush the scriptures against one's body'; the rest of the garbled commentary likewise rendered as fluent prose

defects.detail: standalone 憍 (dozens of times, e.g. 憍界, 憍衣, 取憍) rendered as the place name 'Kauśāmbī' throughout ('Kauśāmbī robe', 'Kauśāmbī boundary'), unsupported by the source
